name: ISBD 28th Annual Conference 2026
description: The 28th ISBD Annual Conference runs September 28 to 30, 2026, at the Westin Bayshore in Vancouver with about 700 attendees expected. All abstract and travel award submissions are closed and notifications have been sent; registration remains open.

deadlines.label: Abstract, symposium and workshop submission
deadlines.note: closed; the deadline date is no longer displayed; late abstracts not considered

deadlines.label: Early mid career travel award application
deadlines.note: closed; supported by the Baszucki Group

deadlines.label: Hotel block reservation
deadlines.note: CAD 379 group rate, or until sold out

sources.note: Dates, venue, submissions closed, cancellation and hotel deadlines, CME credits

notes: The ISBD submissions page (isbd.org/submissions) returns 404, so the 2026 abstract deadline could not be recovered. One ISBD news post gives the dates as September 29 to 30; the conference page and program (opening ceremony Monday September 28) support September 28 to 30.

name: ISBD 29th Annual Conference 2027
description: ISBD has announced that its 2027 annual conference will be held in Porto, Portugal. Dates, venue and submission deadlines have not been published.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission
deadlines.note: not announced; the 2026 cycle had closed with notifications sent before September 2026, and recent conferences have been held in September

sources.note: Announces 2027 meeting in Porto, Portugal; further details to come

notes: Only the city is confirmed. Recent ISBD conferences ran in September (Chiba 2025, Vancouver 2026), so a September 2027 date is plausible but unconfirmed.
